negative_snippets:
Not a good experience.

I visited the hotel in morning.

They showed my various rooms, but most of them were smelly. They mentioned they'll spray room freshener but I couldn't bear that smell.

Rooms were small and paint was coming out of walls in some rooms. Neither of the rooms were decent ones. Nor the lighting was seeming good. Even the linen was not clean properly. Rooms seemed to be very dusky and the price asked was way too much for the kind of room being offered. They were asking around 2-2.5k/night, Which was not at all worth it.

Advice -Visit the hotel before booking (if possible)

Thanks for reading.
Hope it helps you to make the right decision!

Rooms are not clean. Dirt on the floor , all electric switch board covers gone, no proper light in bathroom. Geysers does not work properly . Washroom is dirty.

They just need little money to upgrade hotel to the best one , but looks they don’t want to do it.

I do not recommend it.
